Money · in French

Car-free living calculator

What your car really costs each year (depreciation or lease payments, loan interest, insurance, servicing, fuel, parking) against bikes, public transport, trains, car sharing, taxis and an occasional rental. The yearly saving, or loss, of living without a car, with the cost of getting out of a loan, a lease with purchase option or a long-term lease included, the best time to exit, and several scenarios side by side. Every amount is yours: no fares or fuel prices are built in. A plan for each situation where the car would be missed (a night-time emergency, a sick child at school, holidays) and a trial period before selling. A simulation, not financial advice.
